analysis: The PR only modifies AGENTS.md, a contributor/agent guidance document, and no runtime source. The patch rewords the modularity guidance, adds a 'Clean Code' section, and adds a 'Required Refactor Pass' section that requires a dedicated refactor subagent before opening a PR. The new text states that security controls, admission checks, and tests must not be weakened during refactoring. It does not alter trust boundaries, attestation, encryption, billing, App Attest authorization, or any code path. I traced it against the threat model assets, boundaries and threats (including T-041 and the TB-* entries) and found no new attack surface, invalidated assumption, or required threat-model update. One process note, not a finding: the instruction to hand the diff to a subagent could expose unpublished changes to another agent, but that is a workflow matter outside the runtime threat model. The covered units are the metadata unit, the patch, and the base/head text units, with the head text compared against the base. The base_text unit 7044ada49af013da:3 contains only the tail lines 358 onward, so I did not see base lines 342-357 in that unit. They appear in the patch and in the full base text unit.
